files.purpose: Every setting in one place: names, ports, threads, the 5 GB model limit, model file names, search, answer lengths, voice.
The two Python packages QuantaKai needs. Everything else uses Python's built-in library.
Marks the app folder as a Python package, so the files can import each other (from . import library).
Loads config.json and defines every folder path. Every other module imports its paths and settings from here.
The written instructions the model receives before the user's message, one block per mode and style.
Starts, stops and switches the two llama-server processes, and enforces the model size limit.
Talks to the engines over HTTP with Python's built-in urllib (OpenAI-compatible API).
The book library: reads books and notes, cuts them into passages, builds vectors, sorts books into subjects, and searches.
Long-term memory: facts about the user in data\memory.json, each with its search vector.
Online mode: searches DuckDuckGo's plain-HTML page, reads the top 3 pages in parallel and keeps the paragraphs that best match the question.
Runs Python or Java code from an answer on this laptop (the Run button) and returns its output.
Reads the text in a picture (a screenshot of a question, a photo of notes) with the text recognition built into Windows 10/11.
Documents attached to one chat: read once, saved beside the chat, and their most relevant parts sent with each question in that chat.
Tidies downloads: files dropped in a "new stuff" or "inbox" folder inside QuantaKai are moved to the right folder at start-up.
A helper program that keeps the Kokoro voice loaded in memory and turns each line of text it receives into a WAV file.
Offline voice: speech-to-text with whisper.cpp, and reading answers aloud with Kokoro or Piper (Windows voices are the page's last resort).
Builds every reply: loads the chat, gathers memories, book passages, web extracts or attached documents, fits everything into the context window, streams, saves.
The local web server: serves the page and the JSON API, starts the engines, opens the browser.
Used by STOP.bat: stops the app and both engines (process names are checked first).
The whole interface in one file: HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no libraries, no internet.
Double-click to run QuantaKai with its own portable Python. Keep the black window open while you use it.
Double-click to stop everything (for example after the START window was closed oddly).
Runs scripts\setup.ps1, which does the download steps of this guide automatically.
Runs scripts\setup_voice.ps1 (whisper.cpp, the Whisper model, Piper and a voice).
Automatic setup: portable Python and its packages, the llama.cpp CPU engine, both models, a speed test. Safe to run again.
Downloads whisper.cpp (whisper-cli), the Whisper base.en model, Piper and the en_US-hfc_female-medium voice into the voice folder.
The short reminder kept in the QuantaKai folder: start, stop, voice, and what each folder holds.
A stand-in for llama-server used only by tests: answers /health, chat (streamed and not) and embeddings with predictable fake data.
Checks the whole app in a temporary copy with the fake engine: start-up, the size limit, adding a book, study answers with sources, chat, memory, saved chats, security.
